subject: Kickoff: advice-based frequency-moment estimation for telemetry
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kicking off moment_advice (Mar 23 – Jul 6). The open-source release estimates frequency moments by sampling according to advice, benchmarked against three baselines: perfect advice (exact frequencies), PPSWOR ell_1 sampling, and ell_2 sampling. It supports exactly the input shapes our infra customers have — graph edges for in/out degree moments (with parallel edges counted) and net_traffic packets keyed by unordered IP pairs.

Product case: the telemetry team samples network flows today with plain ell_1-style sampling and their heavy-hitter estimates degrade on skewed traffic. Learned advice should cut estimation error substantially at the same sample budget — that's the pitch to make it a platform primitive.

Milestones: April — reproduce baselines on public graph datasets; late May — advice models trained on our telemetry history; late June — full-scale validation; Jul 6 close with an adoption recommendation.

Staffing + compute by mid-April please.

Anders
